target.rawSql:
WITH regimes(underlying, start_minutes, regime_name, drawdown_pct) AS (
  VALUES
    ('SPX', 0, 'Morning', 60),
    ('SPX', 120, 'Late morning', 90),
    ('SPX', 240, 'Afternoon', 75),
    ('NDX', 0, 'Morning', 100),
    ('NDX', 120, 'Late morning', 95),
    ('NDX', 240, 'Afternoon', 90),
    ('XSP', 0, 'Morning', 80),
    ('XSP', 120, 'Late morning', 90),
    ('XSP', 240, 'Afternoon', 85)
), boundaries AS (
  SELECT ('$session_date'::date + TIME '09:30'
    + start_minutes * INTERVAL '1 minute') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS time,
    regime_name || ' - ' || drawdown_pct::text || '% drawdown' AS text,
    'drawdown-regime' AS tags
  FROM regimes WHERE underlying = '$underlying'
)
SELECT time, text, tags FROM boundaries WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

SELECT ts AS time, CASE event_type WHEN 'trade_entered' THEN 'Entered' WHEN 'exit_signal_fired' THEN 'Exit signal: ' || COALESCE(data->>'reason', '') WHEN 'trade_exited' THEN 'Exited: ' || COALESCE(data->>'exit_reason', '') ELSE 'Market data unavailable' END AS text, event_type AS tags FROM decision_log WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_type IN ('trade_entered', 'exit_signal_fired', 'trade_exited', 'position_market_data_unavailable') ORDER BY ts

panels.description: Selected underlying's trade for the session on screen. P&L and value are live from the latest monitoring quote while open.

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND trade_date = '$session_date'::date AND status != 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 1), q AS (SELECT (SELECT fly_mark FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE trade_id = t.id AND underlying = t.underlying ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS mark, (SELECT drawdown_pct FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE trade_id = t.id AND underlying = t.underlying ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS dd FROM t WHERE t.status = 'OPEN'), s AS (SELECT price, ts FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), v AS (SELECT price FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$VIX' AND ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), em AS (SELECT (es.price * (ev.price / 100.0) / SQRT(252))::float AS pts FROM t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ts <= t.entry_time ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) es CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$VIX' AND ts <= t.entry_time ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) ev) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'OPEN' THEN 'OPEN' ELSE COALESCE(exit_reason, status) END FROM t), 'no trade') AS "Position", (SELECT (COALESCE(t.pnl, (SELECT mark FROM q) - t.entry_price) * 100 * t.quantity)::float FROM t) AS "P&L", (SELECT (COALESCE(CASE WHEN t.status = 'OPEN' THEN (SELECT mark FROM q) END, t.exit_price) * 100 * t.quantity)::float FROM t) AS "Value", (SELECT ((t.peak_value - t.entry_price) * 100 * t.quantity)::float FROM t) AS "Best P&L", (SELECT dd::float FROM q) AS "Off peak", (SELECT (s.price - t.center_strike)::float FROM t, s) AS "Spot − center", (SELECT pts FROM em) AS "1σ move", (SELECT price::float FROM v) AS "VIX", (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ts) * 1000 FROM s) AS "Spot updated"

panels.title: $underlying vs Breakevens

targets.rawSql: WITH spot_path AS (SELECT ts AS time, price::float AS price, 0 AS source_priority FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND $__timeFilter(ts) UNION ALL SELECT ts AS time, spot_price::float AS price, 1 AS source_priority FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND spot_price IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts)) SELECT DISTINCT ON (time) time, price AS "Spot" FROM spot_path ORDER BY time, source_priority

WITH samples AS (SELECT ts FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND $__timeFilter(ts) UNION SELECT ts FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND $__timeFilter(ts)), trade AS (SELECT lower_strike, center_strike, upper_strike, entry_price FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND entry_time >= $__timeFrom() AND entry_time <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY entry_time LIMIT 1) SELECT samples.ts AS time, trade.upper_strike::float AS "upper_wing", (trade.upper_strike - trade.entry_price)::float AS "upper_be", trade.center_strike::float AS "center", (trade.lower_strike + trade.entry_price)::float AS "lower_be", trade.lower_strike::float AS "lower_wing" FROM samples CROSS JOIN trade ORDER BY samples.ts

SELECT t.entry_time AS time, COALESCE((SELECT price FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ts <= t.entry_time ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), NULLIF(t.metadata->>'entry_spot', '')::numeric, (SELECT spot_price FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND trade_id = t.id AND spot_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1))::float AS "Entry" FROM butterfly_trades t WHERE t.underlying = '$underlying' AND t.status != 'CANCELLED' AND t.entry_time >= $__timeFrom() AND t.entry_time <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY t.entry_time LIMIT 1

SELECT t.exit_time AS time, COALESCE((SELECT price FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ts <= t.exit_time ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT spot_price FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND trade_id = t.id AND spot_price IS NOT NULL AND ts <= t.exit_time ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1))::float AS "Exit" FROM butterfly_trades t WHERE t.underlying = '$underlying' AND t.status != 'CANCELLED' AND t.exit_time IS NOT NULL AND t.entry_time >= $__timeFrom() AND t.entry_time <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY t.entry_time LIMIT 1
SELECT ts AS time, lower_tent AS "lower_tent", upper_tent AS "upper_tent" FROM tent_boundaries WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.book AS "Book", t.id AS "Trade", CASE WHEN t.id IS NULL THEN 'no trade' WHEN t.status = 'OPEN' THEN 'OPEN' ELSE COALESCE(t.exit_reason, t.status) END AS "Status", left(t.direction, 1) || ' ' || t.center_strike::int || 'w' || t.wing_width AS "Fly", (COALESCE(t.pnl, CASE WHEN t.status = 'OPEN' THEN (SELECT fly_mark FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE trade_id = t.id AND underlying = t.underlying ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) END - t.entry_price) * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "P&L" FROM (VALUES (1, 'SPX'), (2, 'NDX'), (3, 'XSP')) AS u(ord, book) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = u.book AND trade_date = '$session_date'::date AND status != 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 1) t ON TRUE ORDER BY u.ord

SELECT to_char(trade_date, 'MM-DD') AS "Date", id AS "Trade", left(direction, 1) || ' ' || center_strike::int || 'w' || wing_width AS "Fly", COALESCE(exit_reason, status) AS "Exit", (pnl * 100 * quantity)::float AS "P&L" FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND trade_date <= '$session_date'::date AND ('${strategy_datasource:raw}' = 'timescaledb' OR metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1') ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 10

targets.rawSql:
WITH policies(underlying, settings) AS (
  VALUES
    ('SPX', '{"strategy": "peakvaluetrailer", "regimes": {"morning": {"start_minutes_after_open": 0, "end_minutes_after_open": 120, "drawdown_threshold": 0.6, "confirmation_polls": 1, "min_peak_profit_ratio": 1.0, "min_hold_minutes": 0.0}, "late_morning": {"start_minutes_after_open": 120, "end_minutes_after_open": 240, "drawdown_threshold": 0.9, "confirmation_polls": 1, "min_peak_profit_ratio": 1.0, "min_hold_minutes": 0.0}, "afternoon": {"start_minutes_after_open": 240, "end_minutes_after_open": 390, "drawdown_threshold": 0.75, "confirmation_polls": 1, "min_peak_profit_ratio": 1.0, "min_hold_minutes": 0.0}}, "max_loss_from_cost": 0.5, "use_absolute_loss_stop": false, "profitprotector": {"breakeven_activation_profit": 1.0, "breakeven_floor_profit": 0.0, "profit_lock_activation_profit": 2.0, "profit_lock_floor_profit": 0.75, "large_peak_profit_ratio": 2.0, "large_peak_drawdown_threshold": 0.5}}'::jsonb),
    ('NDX', '{"strategy": "peakvaluetrailer", "regimes": {"morning": {"start_minutes_after_open": 0, "end_minutes_after_open": 120, "drawdown_threshold": 1.0, "confirmation_polls": 3, "min_peak_profit_ratio": 1.5, "min_hold_minutes": 0.0}, "late_morning": {"start_minutes_after_open": 120, "end_minutes_after_open": 240, "drawdown_threshold": 0.95, "confirmation_polls": 2, "min_peak_profit_ratio": 1.5, "min_hold_minutes": 0.0}, "afternoon": {"start_minutes_after_open": 240, "end_minutes_after_open": 390, "drawdown_threshold": 0.9, "confirmation_polls": 2, "min_peak_profit_ratio": 1.5, "min_hold_minutes": 0.0}}, "max_loss_from_cost": 0.5, "use_absolute_loss_stop": false, "profitprotector": {"breakeven_activation_profit": 1.0, "breakeven_floor_profit": 0.0, "profit_lock_activation_profit": 2.0, "profit_lock_floor_profit": 0.75, "large_peak_profit_ratio": 2.0, "large_peak_drawdown_threshold": 0.5}}'::jsonb),
    ('XSP', '{"strategy": "profitprotector", "regimes": {"morning": {"start_minutes_after_open": 0, "end_minutes_after_open": 120, "drawdown_threshold": 0.8, "confirmation_polls": 3, "min_peak_profit_ratio": 1.25, "min_hold_minutes": 30.0}, "late_morning": {"start_minutes_after_open": 120, "end_minutes_after_open": 240, "drawdown_threshold": 0.9, "confirmation_polls": 3, "min_peak_profit_ratio": 1.25, "min_hold_minutes": 45.0}, "afternoon": {"start_minutes_after_open": 240, "end_minutes_after_open": 390, "drawdown_threshold": 0.85, "confirmation_polls": 3, "min_peak_profit_ratio": 1.25, "min_hold_minutes": 45.0}}, "max_loss_from_cost": 0.5, "use_absolute_loss_stop": false, "profitprotector": {"breakeven_activation_profit": 1.0, "breakeven_floor_profit": 0.0, "profit_lock_activation_profit": 2.0, "profit_lock_floor_profit": 0.75, "large_peak_profit_ratio": 2.0, "large_peak_drawdown_threshold": 0.5}}'::jsonb)
), observations AS (
  SELECT q.ts AS time, t.id AS trade_id, t.entry_price, t.entry_time, t.quantity,
    MAX(q.peak_value) AS peak, MAX(q.fly_mark) AS current
  FROM monitoring_leg_quotes q
  JOIN butterfly_trades t ON t.id = q.trade_id AND t.underlying = q.underlying
  WHERE q.underlying = '$underlying' AND t.trade_date = '$session_date'::date
    AND t.status != 'CANCELLED' AND q.ts >= '$session_date'::date
  GROUP BY q.ts, t.id, t.entry_price, t.entry_time, t.quantity
), history AS (
  SELECT *, BOOL_OR(current >= entry_price) OVER (
    PARTITION BY trade_id ORDER BY time ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
  ) OR peak > entry_price AS ever_in_profit,
    GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      (time AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::time - TIME '09:30'
    )) / 60) AS minutes_after_open,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - entry_time)) / 60 AS age_minutes
  FROM observations
), regimes AS (
  SELECT h.*, p.settings, p.settings->'regimes'->(CASE
    WHEN minutes_after_open < (p.settings #>> '{regimes,morning,end_minutes_after_open}')::float
      THEN 'morning'
    WHEN minutes_after_open < (p.settings #>> '{regimes,late_morning,end_minutes_after_open}')::float
      THEN 'late_morning'
    ELSE 'afternoon' END) AS regime
  FROM history h CROSS JOIN policies p WHERE p.underlying = '$underlying'
), levels AS (
  SELECT *, ever_in_profit
    AND peak >= entry_price * (regime->>'min_peak_profit_ratio')::float
    AND age_minutes >= (regime->>'min_hold_minutes')::float AS armed,
    peak * (1 - CASE WHEN settings->>'strategy' = 'profitprotector'
      AND entry_price > 0
      AND peak >= entry_price * (settings #>> '{profitprotector,large_peak_profit_ratio}')::float
      THEN LEAST((regime->>'drawdown_threshold')::float,
        (settings #>> '{profitprotector,large_peak_drawdown_threshold}')::float)
      ELSE (regime->>'drawdown_threshold')::float END) AS trailing_level
  FROM regimes
)
SELECT time, (peak * 100 * quantity)::float AS "Peak",
  (current * 100 * quantity)::float AS "Current",
  (GREATEST(
    CASE WHEN (settings->>'use_absolute_loss_stop')::boolean AND entry_price > 0
      THEN entry_price * (1 - (settings->>'max_loss_from_cost')::float) END,
    CASE WHEN armed THEN trailing_level END,
    CASE WHEN armed AND settings->>'strategy' = 'profitprotector' AND entry_price > 0
      AND peak >= entry_price + (settings #>> '{profitprotector,breakeven_activation_profit}')::float
      THEN entry_price + (settings #>> '{profitprotector,breakeven_floor_profit}')::float END,
    CASE WHEN armed AND settings->>'strategy' = 'profitprotector' AND entry_price > 0
      AND peak >= entry_price + (settings #>> '{profitprotector,profit_lock_activation_profit}')::float
      THEN entry_price + (settings #>> '{profitprotector,profit_lock_floor_profit}')::float END
  ) * 100 * quantity)::float AS "Exit trigger"
FROM levels WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Exit trigger is the armed price-based exit level using the configured profit policy and Eastern time regime: peak × (1 − drawdown), including enabled profit floors and absolute loss stops. Values are total position dollars (×100×quantity). No line means no price-based exit is armed. Confirmation polls and quote-quality gates still apply; this is a trigger, not a guaranteed fill. Time-based exits and cash settlement are separate. Uses a snapshot of current bot settings.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, price FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$VIX' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY time

WITH rows AS (
  SELECT d.*, t.quantity
  FROM decision_log d
  LEFT JOIN butterfly_trades t
    ON t.underlying = d.underlying
   AND t.id = CASE WHEN d.data->>'trade_id' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (d.data->>'trade_id')::int END
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d.ts)
    AND d.event_type != 'position_held_quote_shadow'
    AND NOT (d.event_type = 'entry_blocked' AND d.data->>'reason' LIKE 'max_trades_reached%')
    AND d.underlying = '$underlying'
)
SELECT
  ts AS "Time",
  data->>'trade_id' AS trade_id,
  event_type AS "Event",
  CASE event_type
    WHEN 'trade_entered' THEN
      'fill=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'cost', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  width=' || (data->>'width') || '  center=' || (data->>'center') || '  dir=' || (data->>'direction') || '  step=' || (data->>'entry_step')
    WHEN 'entry_step_unfilled' THEN
      'step=' || (data->>'step') || '  center=' || (data->>'center') || '  width=' || (data->>'width') || '  mark=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'mark', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  ask=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'ask', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  limit=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'limit', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?')
    WHEN 'entry_exhausted' THEN
      'direction=' || (data->>'direction') || '  — no fill after all steps'
    WHEN 'exit_signal_fired' THEN
      'reason=' || (data->>'reason') || '  mark=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'mark_value', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  peak=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'peak_value', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  drawdown=' || (data->>'drawdown_pct') || '%  regime=' || (data->>'regime')
    WHEN 'trade_exited' THEN
      'reason=' || (data->>'exit_reason') || '  entry=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'entry_price', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  mark_signal=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'mark_at_signal', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  bid=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'spread_bid', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  mark=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'spread_mark', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  fill=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'fill_price', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  pnl=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'pnl', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(data->>'forced', '')::boolean, false) THEN '  [FORCED]' ELSE '' END
    WHEN 'profit_state_transition' THEN
      (data->>'from') || ' → ' || (data->>'to') || '  mark=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'mark_value', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  peak=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(data->>'peak_value', '')::float * 100 * COALESCE(quantity, 1))::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || '  regime=' || (data->>'regime')
    WHEN 'entry_failed' THEN
      'center=' || (data->>'center')
    ELSE data::text
  END AS "Details"
FROM rows
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  scan_time AS time,
  direction,
  wing_width AS width,
  center_strike AS center,
  ROUND((cost * 100)::numeric, 2) AS cost,
  ROUND((max_profit * 100)::numeric, 2) AS max_profit,
  ROUND(reward_risk::numeric, 1) AS rr,
  ROUND(lower_be::numeric, 0) AS lower_be,
  ROUND(upper_be::numeric, 0) AS upper_be,
  selected
FROM butterfly_candidates
WHERE $__timeFilter(scan_time)
  AND underlying = '$underlying'
ORDER BY scan_time DESC, rr DESC
LIMIT 50
SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT snapshot_time)::float AS value FROM option_chain_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_time) AND underlying = '$underlying'
SELECT ts AS time, price FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY time
